name: devilsrock.de
description: Devils Rock Trails website (Astro, served by Cloudflare Workers)

scripts.build: find public -name .DS_Store -delete && astro build && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler dev --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm test && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
